proposals.before: On jiyou his illness turned critical; Grand Secretaries Gao Gong, Zhang Juyi, and Gao Yi were summoned to receive his deathbed charge.
proposals.after: On jiyou his illness turned critical; Grand Secretaries Gao Gong, Zhang Juzheng, and Gao Yi were summoned to receive his deathbed charge.
proposals.reason: Chinese 張居正 is Zhang Juzheng; Zhang Juyi is a mistransliteration of the same name already rendered Zhang Juzheng elsewhere in the chapter.
